lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct vertical white lines are visible across the dark grey torso. The spacing is relatively uniform in the anterior and mid-sections, with segments becoming more compressed and less continuous toward the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A downward-oriented Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the 4th vertical line from the anterior edge, positioned approximately at the vertical midpoint of the torso mass.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The posterior-most line segments (lines 9-11) appear as abbreviated or dashed marks that terminate significantly above the ventral fringe boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 3 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower left haunch, situated immediately above the transition point to the tan lower limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two distinct spots on the upper-mid haunch align horizontally to form a short, semi-connected geometric line.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns exhibit a lyrate spiral trajectory; the base vectors upward and backward before twisting medially and anteriorly at the distal ends.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the horn tips is approximately 2.5 times the width of the individual horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping comprises approximately 15% of the total vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Bright white V-shaped chevron between the eyes; prominent white patch on the throat; dark ventral fringe extending from throat to abdomen; distinct tan/ochre coloration on all four lower limbs below the knee/hock.
